overloadMerges.note: booleanArr's doc arrow is output-only ('<-') -- it is filled by the command, not read -- so direction must be 'out', not the auto-derived 'in'. set is given its documented default (UserSet in the current process).

params.name: booleanArr
params.description: Filled with one element per record (by absolute record number): True if the record belongs to set, False otherwise

params.name: set
params.description: Name of the set to test membership against
params.default: UserSet in the current process, if omitted

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Fills a Boolean array, one element per record in the table (indexed by absolute record number), indicating whether each record belongs to the given (or default UserSet) set.

constraints: The total number of elements filled in booleanArr is not guaranteed to equal the number of records actually present in the table; any extra elements are set to False.
